# Hackettstown Junk Removal

> Same-day junk removal in Hackettstown NJ and Warren County. We haul furniture, appliances, construction debris, estate cleanouts, yard waste, hot tubs, electronics, and more. Upfront pricing, eco-friendly disposal. Phone: (862) 244-3630.

## About

Hackettstown Junk Removal is a local junk hauling company serving Hackettstown NJ and the surrounding Warren County and Morris County communities. We provide full-service junk removal — our crew does all the lifting, loading, and disposal. We offer same-day and next-day appointments, free upfront quotes, and eco-friendly disposal with donation and recycling of usable items.

## Services

- Furniture Removal
- Appliance Removal (refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves)
- Estate & House Cleanouts
- Construction Debris Removal (drywall, lumber, tile, concrete)
- Yard Waste & Brush Removal
- Hot Tub & Shed Removal
- Electronics & E-Waste Removal
- Office & Commercial Junk Removal
- Storage Unit Cleanouts
- Hoarding Cleanouts

## Pricing

- Single item: Starting at $75
- Full truckload estate cleanout: Up to $500+
- Pricing is based on volume and item type
- Free upfront quotes — no hidden fees

## FAQ

**How much does junk removal cost in Hackettstown NJ?**
Starts at $75 for a single item, up to $500+ for a full truckload estate cleanout. Upfront pricing — no hidden fees.

**Do you offer same-day service?**
Yes, same-day junk removal is available throughout Warren County NJ when slots are open. Contact before noon for best availability.

**What items won't you remove?**
We cannot haul hazardous waste: paint (unless dried), chemicals, asbestos, biohazard materials, propane tanks, or motor oil. Almost everything else we can handle.

**Do you donate or recycle items?**
Yes. Usable furniture and household items go to local charities. Electronics go to certified e-waste recyclers. We divert 40–60% of hauls from the landfill.

**Do I need to be home?**
No. As long as items are accessible and payment is arranged in advance, we can complete the pickup while you are away. We send a confirmation photo when done.
